zh: 终端面板支持标准终端快捷键与按键拦截，隔离页面快捷键（如 Ctrl+R/U/P 等），防止误触全局操作。
增强终端复制粘贴体验：支持快捷键与右键直接粘贴，支持 macOS 行编辑、全选、清屏与字体缩放。
Agent 遇到各类登录命令时自动切换至交互终端运行，并自动剔除管道传入的陈旧凭据。
en: Terminal panel now intercepts standard terminal keys (Ctrl+R/U/P) and prevents triggering page-level shortcuts.
Enhanced copy & paste in terminal: supports multi-key shortcuts, right-click paste, macOS line editing, clear, and font zoom.
Agent login commands are automatically upgraded to run interactively in the terminal with stale piped credentials dropped.
